execution_gate.rule: The operator authorized execution of the 60 predeclared discovery trials only (mission V4-BATCH03-DISCOVERY-THEN-CAPITAL-FRACTION-DAEMON-CLOSURE-01). Required order: fetch and verify bars, register all 60 trials, prove 60 trials and 0 attempts, then execute. No confirmation trial, holdout consumption, Promotion, Paper deployment or Live action is authorized.

declaration_selection: run_batch.py and summarize_batch.py read this file when MQK_M1_BATCH_DECLARATION names it.
protocol_note: Hypothesis != trial != attempt != evaluation slice != robustness scenario: ten families, one trial per (family, symbol) = 60 trials, one disclosed selection population. A robustness stress is an evaluation of the SAME registered trial, never a trial.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multi-horizon absolute (time-series) momentum is a documented, economically motivated trend effect; a 2-of-3 consensus across one-, three- and twelve-month horizons is the single predeclared aggregation. Falsifiable; no profitability is assumed.
hypotheses.rule: At each canonical month-end session t: vote +1 for each of close[t]>close[t-21], close[t]>close[t-63], close[t]>close[t-252] (strict). TARGET +1 iff votes>=2 of 3; otherwise 0. The target is held unchanged until the next month-end.

special_cases.same_bar_fill: never; execution is a strictly later bar

hypotheses.no_variants: no other thresholds, horizons, hold lengths, multipliers or stops are registered or evaluated

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-horizon oversold readings inside a long-term uptrend tend to mean-revert (liquidity-provision/short-term reversal). Falsifiable.
hypotheses.rule: trend = close[t] > SMA200 (latest 200 closes including t). RSI5 = Cutler RSI from the five most recent 1-session close differences (RSI=50 when gains+losses==0). While FLAT: enter iff trend and RSI5<30 (strict). While LONG: exit iff RSI5>70 (strict) or trend is false. State is reconstructed from the bounded window by replay.

special_cases.same_bar_fill: never; execution is a strictly later bar

hypotheses.economic_rationale: An extreme 3-day decline relative to recent range inside an uptrend is a liquidity-shock overreaction that tends to partially reverse. Falsifiable.
hypotheses.rule: trend as F02. ATR20 = mean true range over the 20 sessions immediately BEFORE t (event bar excluded). drop_fraction=(close[t-3]-close[t])/close[t-3]; atr_fraction=ATR20_prior/close[t-1]. Event iff trend and drop_fraction>1.5*atr_fraction (strict). On an event the target is +1 for EXACTLY 5 subsequent strategy outputs; no extension, no resize, no re-trigger while held.

special_cases.same_bar_fill: never; execution is a strictly later bar

hypotheses.no_variants: no other thresholds, horizons, hold lengths, multipliers or stops are registered or evaluated

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Close-based channel breakouts capture medium-term trend persistence with an asymmetric (slower) exit. Falsifiable.
hypotheses.rule: While FLAT: enter iff close[t] > max(close[t-100..t-1]) (strict, current bar excluded). While LONG: exit iff close[t] < min(close[t-50..t-1]) (strict, current bar excluded). State reconstructed by replay.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: A 10-month moving-average timing rule is a documented, widely replicated tactical trend filter. Falsifiable.
hypotheses.rule: At each canonical month-end session t: mean10 = mean of the PRIOR 10 month-end closes (the current month-end excluded). TARGET +1 iff close[t] > mean10 (strict); equality is flat. Held until the next month-end.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-horizon statistical dislocation below a rolling mean inside an uptrend tends to mean-revert. Falsifiable.
hypotheses.rule: trend as F02. mean20 and POPULATION std20 over close[t-20..t-1] (current bar excluded). std20<=0: no entry. z=(close[t]-mean20)/std20. While FLAT: enter iff trend and z<-2.0 (strict). While LONG: exit iff close[t]>=mean20 or trend is false.

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Volatility compression followed by a range expansion upward marks the start of directional moves. Falsifiable.
hypotheses.rule: range10=max(high[t-10..t-1])-min(low[t-10..t-1]); range60 likewise over 60 bars (current bar excluded). contraction iff range60>0 and range10*4<range60 (strict, i.e. range10<25% of range60). level=max(close[t-20..t-1]). While FLAT: enter iff contraction and close[t]>level. While LONG: exit iff close[t]<min(close[t-10..t-1]) (strict).

hypotheses.rule: At each canonical month-end session t: TARGET +1 iff close[t-21] > close[t-252] (strict; the current close is never read). Held until the next month-end.

hypotheses.rule: gap_fraction=(close[t-1]-open[t])/close[t-1]; atr_fraction=ATR20_prior/close[t-1] (ATR20 over the 20 sessions before t). Event iff gap_fraction>1.5*atr_fraction (strict). The signal is emitted only after bar t completes; the target is +1 for EXACTLY 3 subsequent strategy outputs; no extension, no same-day or open fill.

universe.selection_rule: Fixed ex-ante liquid ETF list (broad equity, growth, small-cap and three high-volatility sectors). Individual stocks are excluded.
universe.survivorship_note: A fixed list of long-lived, still-listed ETFs is not point-in-time clean; each symbol is its own registered trial and the judge deflates over all sixty.

experiment.population_policy: ONE experiment id holds the ten families and all sixty trials. The multiple-testing judge scope is the experiment id with hypothesis_id unset: ONE batch-wide selection population of all 60; losing and failed trials are never excluded.

data.verification_required_before_registratio: fetch/verify provider bars for all six symbols, record the provenance manifest and row counts; any symbol without sufficient adjusted history is reported, never substituted

partition.holdout_rule: the final 6 calendar months (from 2026-03-01) are RESERVED / UNCONSUMED; discovery bars are truncated before the holdout start
partition.warmup_note: Engines needing 253-275 completed bars are structurally flat in the early part of fold 1; this is disclosed, not corrected.

quantity_semantics.rule: the economic engine holds EXACTLY the native absolute target quantity; ml_score is ignored; no weight re-sizing

native_backtest.bars: the same provenance-bound research bars converted deterministically, truncated at the holdout start

capital_sizing.quantity_rule: Q = floor(position_budget_micros / close_micros of the fully completed strategy bar on which a FLAT strategy emits its new target); position_budget_micros = floor(initial_capital_micros * 1000 / 10000) = USD 10,000; whole shares; refuse (stay flat) if the budget cannot buy one share; no +1 fallback; no compounding; no family-specific sizing; held exactly for the position lifetime

benchmark.cross_substitution: capital_matched_exact_target_buy_hold_v1 is not authorized; cross-substitution fails closed

stress_sizing.quantity_rule: resolve a new stress Q from the same causal completed-bar reference price; do not cap a 1000-bps baseline Q
stress_sizing.identity: the stress is an evaluation scenario of the SAME registered trial; the trial identity stays bound to the 1000 bps baseline; the scenario artifact separately binds the stress sizing, the stress signal stream hash and the execution-stress parameters

p7a_p7b_stress.stress_notional_cap_policy: stress_max_position_notional_usd and stress_max_target_qty are NOT used. A USD 5,000 cap on a 1000-bps quantity is not a half-exposure mechanism and is not a Production default; the independent baseline notional safety cap (USD 50,000) is carried unchanged into the stress.
p7a_p7b_stress.baseline_adversity_check: baseline execution slippage_bps 5 / volatility_mult_bps 0 (economic_protocol.execution_pricing) -> stress 15 / 10: both at least as adverse, both strictly worse.

promotion_policy.note: Thresholds carried over unchanged from Batch 02; no result may reopen them. Discovery never promotes.

execution_fidelity.metric: fraction of evaluated bars on which the simulator's discrete post-order position equals the native desired target quantity

holdout.rule: never consumed by discovery; consumed holdout data is never fresh again; a rerun requiring the holdout is a hard stop

comparison_scope.judge: canonical research_multiple_testing_judge_v1 over the whole experiment; block counts 8/10/12

rank_keys: 1: count of symbols with positive cost-aware benchmark alpha (descending)
2: median DSR across the six slots (descending)
3: median net alpha versus the capital-fraction matched benchmark (descending)
5: median drawdown improvement versus the matched benchmark (descending)
family_ranking.outcome: the top 3 families receive DISCOVERY_ADVANCED_TO_CONFIRMATION; this is NOT Promotion; individual symbol trials are never selected; no Promotion candidate is created from discovery

confirmation_preparation.rule: 3 advanced families x 6 symbols, registered only under a later explicit authorization; history sufficiency is verified at that time; any symbol without sufficient history is reported and never substituted

batch_stopping_rule.infrastructure_failure: retry the same trial under a new attempt id; an economic failure is finalized failed and never retried

attempt_identity_rules: A retry is a new attempt of the SAME trial_id. trial_id derives from experiment, strategy family/version, symbol, canonical timeframe, native inner and capital-wrapped semantic fingerprints, bars provenance, partition, economic protocol, capital sizing and the full stress contract; never from a result value.
forbidden_after_predeclaration: changing symbols, families or trial order
changing any family rule, threshold, horizon, hold length or equality boundary
changing the 1000 bps baseline sizing or the capital basis
changing commission or slippage to improve outcomes
changing the benchmark or falling back to Benchmark V2
changing scanner, Promotion or robustness thresholds
